system.description: The kama is a kind of sickle with a curving blade mounted perpendicular to the handle. It is functionally identical to a sickle with a semicircular blade at the end of the handle. Both sorts are used in agriculture throughout Creation, but the listed traits are for a kama or sickle specially made as a weapon. Both weapons are small and short enough to mimic a person clawing with his nails. A martial artist often carries one kama or sickle in each hand.
